label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from request parameters flows through multiple transformations (Base64 round-trip, substring, split) without HTML encoding. The final 'bar' string is written to the HTML response via PrintWriter.format, allowing injected scripts to execute.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from request parameter.
Base64 encode/decode preserves content without sanitizing HTML tags.
Unsanitized user data written to HTML response writer.
